### LSPrivilege Pre-release

- **Version**: `v1.2` (`604`)
- **Commit**: [`d1dbb2dd`](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPrivilege/commit/d1dbb2dd8525280e87ad8703c414045e14ba56b4)

#### Commit Message
```
feat(profiles): add OPPO A78 5G kernel profile for new OTA update (#998)

* OPPO A78 5G

Adding support for oppo A78 5g

* Update index.conf

* Update SUPPORTED_DEVICES.md

* Update index.conf

* Update SUPPORTED_DEVICES.md
```

#### Files
- `LSPrivilege-release.apk`: LSPrivilege Android Application
- `lsprivilege`: Standalone LSPrivilege native binary (Android arm64-v8a)
- `LSPrivilege-kernel-profiles.zip`: Bundled kernel profiles (HOCON)
- `lsprivilege-extract-android-arm64`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (Android arm64-v8a)
- `lsprivilege-extract-linux-x86_64`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (Linux x86_64)
- `lsprivilege-extract-macos-universal`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (macOS Universal arm64 + x86_64)
- `lsprivilege-extract-windows-x86_64.exe`: Kernel offset extractor CLI (Windows x86_64)

detail.readme:
# LSPrivilege

[中文](README_ZH.md)

LSPrivilege is a modular Android kernel privilege-escalation app for gaining temporary root on supported kernels and loading root managers such as KernelSU or APatch. It is designed to support multiple exploit backends rather than targeting a single vulnerability (currently shipping CVE-2026-43499, with additional backends planned).

## Use the app

1. Install a root manager APK from [KernelSU](https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU), [SukiSU Ultra](https://github.com/SukiSU-Ultra/SukiSU-Ultra), [BakaSU/ReSukiSU](https://github.com/Baka-SU/BakaSU), [KowSU](https://github.com/KOWX712/KernelSU), or [APatch](https://github.com/bmax121/APatch).
2. Install the LSPrivilege APK and open it.
3. Check that your kernel is supported, then tap **Run**.

Support requires an exact `uname -r` match. Check the [supported devices](docs/kernel_profiles/SUPPORTED_DEVICES.md) for your kernel build.

If Shizuku is enabled, start it with ADB before running LSPrivilege. Tap LSPrivilege's status card to grant access.

Any root manager that ships `libksud.so` or `libapd.so` provides `ksud`/`apd` for module loading. The built-in list (KernelSU, SukiSU Ultra, ReSukiSU, BakaSU, KowSU, APatch) is auto-detected, and other managers can be picked in **Settings → Root manager**. Without `ksud`/`apd`, W1/W2 still grant uid 0 but no module is loaded.

## Add a kernel profile

You can import a profile without rebuilding the app:

- **Parse OTA link** accepts a full OTA ZIP URL.
- **Parse local image** accepts `boot.img` and an optional `xbl_config.img`.
- **Import offsets.conf (v2)** accepts a HOCON profile. **Import offsets.json (v1)** converts an older JSON report in the app.

Extractor output is an unverified candidate. The app checks missing or invalid fields before execution. Generating a profile does not prove device support. See the [porting guide](docs/kernel_profiles/README.md) for validation and built-in registration.

See the [MediaTek guide](docs/kernel_profiles/MEDIATEK.md) for image-based address recovery and the rooted-device fallback.

## Command-line tools

<details>
<summary>Run the native binary with an exported profile</summary>

Requires the Android NDK, `make`, Gradle, and ADB. An adb shell run skips the app's seccomp bypass stage.

```sh
make -C src lsprivilege
./gradlew exportKernelProfiles
adb push build/native/lsprivilege /data/local/tmp/lsprivilege
adb push "build/kernel-profiles/<release>.bin" /data/local/tmp/profile.bin
adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/lsprivilege
adb shell /data/local/tmp/lsprivilege --load-prebuilt-profile /data/local/tmp/profile.bin
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>Build and run the offset extractor</summary>

Requires Rust. The extractor accepts a boot image, a full OTA ZIP, or an HTTP(S) URL.

```sh
(cd tools/extract_rs && cargo build --release)
build/extract/release/lsprivilege-extract boot.img --xbl-config xbl_config.img --format conf --out profile.conf
build/extract/release/lsprivilege-extract OTA.zip --format conf --out profile.conf
```

Import `profile.conf` in the app. Omit `--xbl-config` if you do not have that image. The extractor rejects a patched `remove_waiter()` with exit code `6`.

</details>

## Reference

- [Profile schema](docs/kernel_profiles/PROFILE_SCHEMA.md) and [execution defaults](docs/kernel_profiles/defaults.md)
- [Native core](src/core/README.md)
- [Add a component](docs/development/adding-a-component.md), [engineering rules](docs/development/engineering-standards.md), and [writing rules](docs/development/documentation-standards.md)
